CRITICAL.name: data_freshness_exceeded
CRITICAL.condition: Pipeline has not run in more than 24 hours
CRITICAL.message: The data pipeline has not run in over 24 hours. Stale data may lead to incorrect financial reports.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate and restart the pipeline immediately.

CRITICAL.name: data_quality_below_threshold
CRITICAL.message: The data quality percentage is below the required 99.9%. Low-quality data can result in erroneous financial insights.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate and resolve data quality issues immediately.

CRITICAL.name: row_count_out_of_bounds
CRITICAL.condition: Row count is outside the bounds of 17 to 25
CRITICAL.message: The row count is outside the acceptable bounds of 17 to 25. This may impact data completeness.

WARNING.name: runtime_approaching_limit
WARNING.message: The pipeline runtime is approaching the 120-minute limit. This may delay the morning dashboard update.
WARNING.recommended_action: Monitor the pipeline runtime and optimize if necessary.

WARNING.name: data_quality_slightly_below
WARNING.condition: Data quality percentage is slightly below 99.9%
WARNING.message: The data quality percentage is slightly below 99.9%. Investigate to prevent potential issues.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate and address any potential data quality issues.

WARNING.name: merchant_failure_spike
WARNING.condition: One merchant's failure rate spikes above 30%
WARNING.message: One merchant's failure rate has spiked above 30%. Investigate the cause.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate and resolve the issue with the merchant's data processing.

INFO.name: new_payment_method
INFO.condition: A new payment method is detected in the data
INFO.message: A new payment method has been detected in the data. Log this for future reference.
INFO.recommended_action: Log the new payment method for future reference.

INFO.name: row_count_near_bounds
INFO.condition: Daily row count is near the bounds of 17 to 25
INFO.message: The daily row count is near the bounds of 17 to 25. This is within acceptable limits.
INFO.recommended_action: Monitor the row count to ensure it remains within bounds.
